label: Town of Guilford
header: # Town of Guilford -- sweep decisions applied 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Guilford, Annual Town Meeting minutes, February 28, 2026, Article 4 (as amended): Meghan Ohrstrom was nominated 'to fill Sandra's 3 year term' as Library Trustee and Emma Hallowell to the 4-year Library Trustee seat; both had been serving as interim trustees and both were elected by the Article 4 voice vote ('All in Favor'). Recorded elected at Walter's ruling, 2026-10-22, on the sweep report's decision items. The sweep report misstated that an earlier batch had recorded them appointed; in fact no Guilford library post or membership existed.

post_sources.note: The Guilford Free Library board has nine trustees mixing town-elected and association trustees; this post models the town-elected seats filled at town meeting (two, at the February 28, 2026 meeting).
